card.name: Digit 1 inside citation and ID numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes 9 or 7) in the middle of long reference numbers, such as DOI suffixes, PLoS e-numbers and patent numbers. It also fires on single digits within section numbers and statistics.

modes.label: Reference IDs
modes.description: The digit 1 right after a prefix like e, science. or WO/2011/ in a citation or patent number.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A single digit inside a volume, confidence interval or patient count.

card.plain: It marks a digit inside a long reference or ID number, where the next digits are hard to predict.
